SELECT IDX AS no ,TITLE AS title ,CONTENT AS content ,REG_NAME AS name ,REG_DATE AS regDate ,MOD_DATE AS modDate FROM TB_BOARD WHERE 1=1
AND IDX = #{boardVo.no} AND TITLE LIKE '%'||#{boardVo.title}||'%' AND CONTENT LIKE '%'||#{boardVo.content}||'%' AND REG_NAME LIKE '%'||#{boardVo.name}||'%'
AND IDX IN #{item}
Order By no
